div.head: Duns 6.3
div.ab: Gif ðeos lad teorie, gylde twygylde ⁊ hlaforde his wite.
Si lex ista deficiat, reddat tƿigilde (id est duplo gildo) et domino witam suam.
Wenn jene Reinigung misslingt, zahle [Verklagt]er doppelt [dem klagenden Landsmann den Schaden] und [seinem Immunitäts]herrn sein Strafgeld.
If that clearing [oath] fails, let [the accused] pay double [the damage to the native plaintiff] and his fine to [his] lord [with jurisdiction].
If this exculpation fails, he [the defendant] pays double [compensation], and the fine to the lord.

note.seg: Diese Busse (s. d. Gl 13b) und Strafgeldentrichtung, jedenfalls zwischen Parteien Eines Stammes, klingen rein Westsächsisch und gelten daher schwerlich auch für Walliser; s. o. 6, 1¹
This compensation (see that word in Gl 13b) and payment of a fine, at any rate between parties of one people, sound purely West Saxon and therefore hardly apply to the Welsh as well; see above 6, 1¹
